raw_artifacts: Original native files are retained unmodified in private disposable capture directories.
binding_entries: Source and target hashes are verified per edge; some sources are assessment views and are explicitly identified by their source path.
raw_equal_file_entries: Counts byte-equal source/target edges, including view copies; not a count of unique unredacted native artifacts.
path_only_redaction: Two edges redact the same one guide workspace path. The original raw guide hash is retained. No substantive text, code logic or requested detail was rewritten.
assessment_views: Not model conversations; do not add them to session accounting.
